description: The deployed bundle-cache roots a harness really uses, as DATA, so the resolver (`platform_runtime layout bundle-cache-root`) and both enforcement guards read ONE layout instead of each carrying a hard-coded list. Each entry is expanded against the environment: `env` names an environment variable that replaces the base directory when set, `xdg` expands to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME (falling back to $HOME/.config) and `home` expands to $HOME; the value after the base is appended. Only the roots a target actually DEPLOYS bundles to are listed — a discovery-only skill root (a directory another tool reads skills from) is not a deploy root and is deliberately absent. The guards read every target's roots (a machine may carry more than one harness), and a root is compared after realpath, so a symlinked tree is never trusted lexically.
